story: Mia and Sam go to a bookshop on a hot day in February. Mia looks for a blue book, but Sam feels sad because he might lose his hat. Sam tells Mia that there is an egg on the floor below the table. They see nothing else near the egg.
title: A Day at the Bookshop
setting: A small, bright bookshop with shelves of books.

characters.look: A young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt.

characters.name: Sam
